matrix_found: Complete native author feature-by-run quantitative matrix verified at the declared molecular grain; technical runs are not biological subjects. Partial/PSM/single-protein-area records are separately marked author_quantitative_data_found. False means not established in the inspected sources, NOT global nonexistence.
author_quantitative_data_found: Author quantitative tables or records verified, even when incomplete or not eligible as a full GlycoproteomicSE. Null means cannot establish for the target paper.
license_found: Explicit licence evidence located for the matched source, not merely that reuse is permitted. Candidate-only licences are separately explained.
license_permits_intended_reuse: True/false/null; null means licence scope/identity unresolved.
